high_level_description: The image shows a modern cryotherapy chamber, specifically a "CRYO Arctic" unit. The chamber is primarily gray with a sleek, contemporary design. The door of the chamber is closed, and there is a small window on the right side that appears to be frosted or opaque, likely for safety and privacy reasons. On the left side of the door, there is a digital display panel with various controls and indicators. The screen displays some text and numerical values, though they are not entirely clear from the image. There are also several buttons and a red emergency stop button located above the display.
